widget.empty: Connect Last.fm or Spotify in the Music section

noSource: No music sources yet: connect Last.fm or Spotify to see your history, statistics and tops.

lastfm.1: Sign up at last.fm and turn on scrobbling in what you listen with (for Spotify: last.fm → Settings → Applications → Spotify).
lastfm.2: Open last.fm/api/account/create: any application name, the other fields may stay empty; copy the API key.
lastfm.3: Type your Last.fm user name and the key here: the history is imported in the background.

spotify.1: Open developer.spotify.com/dashboard and create an app (any name).
spotify.2: As its Redirect URI, add the address of the dashboard plus /api/music/spotify/callback (Spotify does not accept localhost — use 127.0.0.1 locally).
spotify.3: Put the Client ID and the Client Secret into the server's .env as SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET and restart the dashboard.
spotify.4: Press “Connect” here and allow access in Spotify.

soundcloud.1: Open your profile on soundcloud.com and copy its address — https://soundcloud.com/your-name. That is enough for public tracks.
soundcloud.2: For private tracks: sign in to soundcloud.com, open the developer tools (F12) → Application → Cookies → https://soundcloud.com.
soundcloud.3: Copy the value of the oauth_token cookie and paste it here as the token.
soundcloud.4: The token gives full access to your SoundCloud account: it is stored encrypted on your server and sent only to SoundCloud. It expires when you sign out — then connect again.

soundcloud.playsHistory: Plays of all tracks over 30 days
soundcloud.historyCollecting: Collecting history: SoundCloud gives only the current numbers, so the chart appears from the second day.
soundcloud.notifyOn: Notifications on: new comments and play milestones
soundcloud.noTracks: The profile has no tracks yet.
soundcloud.emptyHint: Your own tracks and mixes with their plays, likes, reposts and comments. Paste the link to your profile in the integrations.

connect.unofficial: SoundCloud gives no official access without a request, so the dashboard reads what the SoundCloud site reads. It may stop working when SoundCloud changes the site.
connect.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect SoundCloud? The saved history of plays will be deleted.
